India's E20 Petrol Mandate Sparks Debate on Mileage, Safety, and Environment

India's nationwide rollout of E20 petrol, a blend of 20% ethanol and 80% gasoline, has generated significant public discussion regarding its impact on vehicle mileage and engine safety. While some reports highlight concerns from gig workers and industry experts about potential engine damage and reduced fuel efficiency, government officials and industry bodies assert that E20 is scientifically tested, safe, and crucial for India's energy security and reducing oil imports. Bhutan has reportedly declined to import E20 fuel from India, citing compatibility issues.
